由 dream 加 -y 构成，义为「梦幻的」

definition_zh: 连衣裙；服装；穿着；打扮；包扎；整理；调味
definition_en: a woman's one-piece garment, or to put clothes on and prepare something carefully
core_image: 一件裙子被平铺在床上，衣摆垂到床沿
scene: 出门前她对着镜子换了三次衣服，最后还是选了那条深色的。She wore a plain black dress to the interview.
sceneCN: 这里 dress 是「连衣裙」（第 1 个义项）；句意是她穿了一条素净的黑裙去面试。

pos.zh: 动词：给……穿衣；包扎；整理；调味

derivatives.zh: 由 dress 加 -ing 构成，义为「调味汁；敷料」
由 dress 加 -er 构成，义为「梳妆台；着装者」
由 dress 加 -y 构成，义为「讲究穿着的；正式的」
由否定前缀 un- 加 dress 构成，义为「脱衣」

senses.title: A woman's one-piece garment
senses.definition: a piece of clothing for a woman or girl that covers the body and part of the legs in one piece
senses.definitionCN: 女性穿的、上衣与裙摆连成一体的服装
senses.example: She bought a cotton dress for the summer.
senses.exampleCN: 她买了一条夏天穿的棉裙。
senses.why: The word came from a verb meaning to arrange or prepare, and a dress is the garment arranged on the body.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自表示「整理、准备」的动词，连衣裙就是被「整理」到身上的那件衣物。

senses.title: Clothing in general, or a style of it
senses.definition: clothes of a particular kind, or the way people wear them
senses.definitionCN: 某一类衣物，或人们的穿着方式
senses.example: The invitation says formal dress is required.
senses.exampleCN: 邀请函上写着须着正装。
senses.why: From one garment the word widened to the whole arrangement of clothes a person puts on.
senses.whyCN: 从一件衣服出发，这个词扩展到一个人穿在身上的整套「整理好的」衣物。

senses.title: To put clothes on someone
senses.definition: to put clothes on yourself or on another person
senses.definitionCN: 给自己或给别人穿上衣服
senses.example: She dressed the children before the school van came.
senses.exampleCN: 校车来之前她给孩子们穿好衣服。
senses.why: Dressing someone is literally arranging them, which is the oldest sense of the verb.
senses.whyCN: 给别人穿衣，字面上就是把人「整理好」，这正是这个动词最古老的用法。

senses.title: To clean and cover a wound
senses.definition: to clean a wound and cover it with a bandage
senses.definitionCN: 清洁伤口并用绷带包好
senses.example: A nurse dressed the cut on his arm.
senses.exampleCN: 一名护士给他胳膊上的伤口做了包扎。
senses.why: Treating a wound is also preparing and arranging it properly, so the same verb serves medicine.
senses.whyCN: 处理伤口同样是把伤口「整理妥当」，所以同一个动词也用于医疗。

senses.title: To prepare food with a sauce
senses.definition: to add oil, vinegar, or sauce to a salad or dish before serving
senses.definitionCN: 在上桌前给沙拉或菜肴加油、醋或酱汁
senses.example: Dress the salad just before you serve it.
senses.exampleCN: 上桌前再给沙拉调味。
senses.why: Preparing a dish for the table is another act of arranging, which is why food is also dressed.
senses.whyCN: 把菜准备上桌也是一次「整理」，所以食物也能被 dress。

senses.title: To arrange or prepare something
senses.definition: to prepare a material such as stone or timber by shaping it
senses.definitionCN: 通过加工使石材、木材等材料成形
senses.example: The workers dressed the stone before laying it.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们在铺砌之前先把石料加工好。
senses.why: This is the verb's original meaning kept alive in crafts: making something fit and orderly.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个动词最本初的意思，在手工行业里保留了下来：把材料弄整齐、弄合用。

intro.en: Dress came through Old French from Latin directus, straight or arranged, so the core idea is setting something in order.
intro.cn: dress 经古法语来自拉丁语 directus（直的、被整理的），核心意思是「把东西摆整齐」。

items.en: Directus meant straight or set right, from the verb dirigere, to guide or align.
items.cn: directus 意为「直的、被摆正的」，源自动词 dirigere（引导、排成直线）。

items.en: Drecier meant to set upright, to arrange, or to prepare.
items.cn: drecier 意为「竖正、整理、准备」。

items.en: English dress first meant to arrange or prepare, including preparing a table or a wound.
items.cn: 英语 dress 最初意为「整理、准备」，包括准备餐桌或处理伤口。

items.en: The clothing sense developed as arranging a person came to mean putting clothes on them.
items.cn: 整理一个人逐渐变成「给人穿衣」，衣着义由此发展出来。

items.en: The noun settled on a one-piece woman's garment, while the verb kept its wider preparing senses.
items.cn: 名词固定指女性连身裙，动词则保留更宽的「整理、加工」义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the stem; the near-meaning group separates garments from clothing in general.
note.cn: 形近组共享词干；近义组把「连衣裙」与「泛指衣物」分开。

entries.definition: A sauce for salads, or a bandage for a wound.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「调味汁；敷料」，由 dress 加 -ing 构成。

entries.definition: A piece of furniture with a mirror, or a person who dresses others.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「梳妆台；着装者」，由 dress 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: To take off one's clothes.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「脱衣」，由 un- 加 dress 构成。

entries.definition: A long formal dress, worn on special occasions.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「长礼服」，多用于正式场合。

entries.definition: Clothes in general, as a mass noun.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「衣物（总称）」，不可数，与 dress 的第二义项相近。

entries.definition: Clothing for a role, a period, or a festival.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「戏服；特定场合的服装」，强调角色或场合。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from the idea of arranging and follow it to clothes, wounds, salad and stone.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从「整理」出发，一路跟到衣服、伤口、沙拉与石料。

normal.en: Directus meant set straight, so dress is about putting things in order.
normal.cn: directus 意为「摆正」，所以 dress 的核心就是「弄整齐」。

normal.en: Putting clothes on a person is arranging them, which is why the verb and the garment share a word.
normal.cn: 给人穿衣就是把人整理好，所以动词与衣物共用一个词。

normal.en: Dress a wound and dress a salad both arrange something for use.
normal.cn: 包扎伤口与给沙拉调味，都是把东西整理到可用状态。

normal.en: Dress code fixes the arrangement everyone must follow.
normal.cn: dress code 规定的是所有人都要遵守的那套「整理方式」。

normal.en: Undress simply reverses the arranging.
normal.cn: undress 就是把这个整理过程倒过来。

abstract.en: Picture a dark dress spread flat across a bed.
abstract.cn: 想象一条深色裙子平铺在床上。

abstract.en: Picture a hand smoothing a bandage over a cut.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把绷带抚平贴在伤口上。

abstract.en: Picture oil being poured slowly over green leaves.
abstract.cn: 想象油缓缓浇在绿叶上。

examples.en: The dress in the window is too expensive for me.
examples.cn: 橱窗里那条裙子对我来说太贵了。

examples.en: He dressed quickly and ran for the train.
examples.cn: 他迅速穿好衣服去赶火车。

examples.en: The nurse dressed the wound with clean cloth.
examples.cn: 护士用干净的布给伤口做了包扎。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「拽丝」——拽起丝质裙摆整理好再穿，dress 既是「连衣裙」，也是「穿衣、整理」。

root: 经古法语 drecier 来自拉丁语 directus（直的、被摆正的），源头是动词 dirigere（引导、排直）。本义是「整理、摆正、准备」，因此既指给人穿衣，也指包扎伤口、给食物调味、加工石料；名词则由「整理好的衣物」固定为女性的连身裙。

sensesIntro.en: One idea of arranging spreads over clothes, wounds, food and materials, while the noun narrows to a garment.
sensesIntro.cn: 「整理」这一个想法铺开到衣服、伤口、食物与材料上，而名词则收窄为一件衣物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a garment laid out flat and smoothed into order.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件衣服被平铺展开，抚平整理。

branches.en: CLOTHES: the noun names a single garment and then clothing in general.
branches.cn: 衣物线：名词先指单件裙装，再泛指衣着，即第一、二个义项。

branches.en: ACTION: arranging a person turns into putting clothes on them.
branches.cn: 动作线：把人整理好，变成给人穿衣，即第三个义项。

branches.en: MEDICINE: a wound is also prepared and covered.
branches.cn: 医疗线：伤口同样要被整理与覆盖，即第四个义项。

branches.en: CRAFT: food and stone are both arranged before use.
branches.cn: 工艺线：食物与石料在上用之前都要被整理，即第五、六个义项。

branches.en: Dressing a child and dressing a wound both mean making something fit and covered.
branches.cn: 给孩子穿衣与给伤口包扎，都是让对象变得妥当并被覆好。

intro.en: Dress is a borrowed stem that takes native English endings and a negative prefix.
intro.cn: dress 是借来的词干，可接英语本土词尾与否定前缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin directus stands at the head of the family; the English forms grew through French.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 directus 位于这个词族的最上游，英语形式经法语长出。

items.example: The Latin adjective is the ultimate source.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁形容词是最初的来源。

items.meaning: a thing or person that does

derivatives.zh: 由 dress 加 -ing 构成，义为「调味汁；敷料」
由 un- 加 dress 构成，义为「脱衣」

definition_zh: 喝；饮；饮料；酒；酗酒
definition_en: to take liquid into the mouth and swallow it, or a liquid you drink
core_image: 一只手把杯子举到嘴边，仰头吞下
scene: 跑完长跑喉咙发烫，他抓过水瓶仰头灌了几口。You should drink more water in hot weather.
sceneCN: 这里 drink 是「喝」（第 1 个义项）；句意是天热时你应该多喝水。

collocations.zh: 软饮料；不含酒精的饮料

derivatives.zh: 由 drink 加 -er 构成，义为「饮酒者」
由 drink 加 -able 构成，义为「可饮用的」
由 drink 加 -ing 构成，义为「饮用；饮酒」

senses.title: To swallow a liquid
senses.definition: to take a liquid into your mouth and send it down your throat
senses.definitionCN: 把液体送入口中并吞下
senses.example: She drank the soup straight from the bowl.
senses.exampleCN: 她直接从碗里把汤喝了。
senses.why: The verb goes back to an old Germanic word for swallowing liquid, and that single action is still its core.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词可追溯到古日耳曼语表示「吞下液体」的词，那个单一动作至今仍是核心。

senses.title: A liquid you can drink
senses.definition: a liquid such as water, juice, or tea that people take in
senses.definitionCN: 水、果汁、茶之类供人饮用的液体
senses.example: The café sells hot drinks and cold drinks.
senses.exampleCN: 这家咖啡馆卖热饮和冷饮。
senses.why: The thing swallowed takes the name of the swallowing, so any potable liquid becomes a drink.
senses.whyCN: 被吞下的东西沿用了「吞」这个动作的名字，于是任何可饮的液体都成了 drink。

senses.title: An alcoholic beverage
senses.definition: an alcoholic beverage, or an occasion of drinking one
senses.definitionCN: 含酒精的饮品，或喝一杯酒的场合
senses.example: They invited us for a drink after work.
senses.exampleCN: 他们请我们下班后去喝一杯。
senses.why: Because alcohol is the drink people most often specify, the unmarked word came to mean liquor by default.
senses.whyCN: 因为人们最常特别指明的饮品是酒，不加修饰的这个词就默认指酒了。

senses.title: To drink alcohol habitually
senses.definition: to consume alcohol regularly, especially too much
senses.definitionCN: 经常饮酒，尤指过量
senses.example: His doctor told him not to drink any more.
senses.exampleCN: 医生让他不要再喝酒了。
senses.why: The habit sense grew out of the default meaning of drink as liquor, especially in medical warnings.
senses.whyCN: 「习惯性饮酒」这层意思是从 drink 默认指酒引申来的，在医学告诫里尤其常见。

intro.en: Drink comes from Old English drincan, a Germanic verb for swallowing liquid, with irregular past forms drank and drunk.
intro.cn: drink 来自古英语 drincan，是日耳曼语中表示吞饮液体的动词，过去式与过去分词不规则，作 drank 与 drunk。

items.en: A root meaning to draw in liquid is usually reconstructed; its exact form remains debated.
items.cn: 一般重构出一个表示「吸入液体」的词根，其确切形式仍有争议。

items.en: The Germanic verb carried the sense of drinking and gave rise to the English word.
items.cn: 日耳曼语的动词带有「饮」义，并催生了英语这个词。

items.en: Drincan was the ordinary verb for drinking, with the past form dranc.
items.cn: drincan 是表示「喝」的常用动词，过去式为 dranc。

items.en: The past forms became drank and drunk and the noun drink was fully in use.
items.cn: 过去形式变成 drank 与 drunk，名词 drink 也已普遍使用。

items.en: The noun took on the sense of liquor, and the verb followed with the habit sense.
items.cn: 名词发展出「酒」义，动词随之有了「习惯性饮酒」义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the stem; the near-meaning group names other ways of taking liquid.
note.cn: 形近组共享词干；近义组收的是其他摄入液体的方式。

entries.definition: A person who drinks, especially alcohol.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「饮酒者」，由 drink 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: Safe and pleasant enough to drink.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「可饮用的」，由 drink 加 -able 构成。

entries.definition: Past participle of drink, also an adjective for being intoxicated.
entries.definitionCN: drink 的过去分词，也作形容词表示「醉的」。

entries.definition: To take small amounts of a drink at a time.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「小口喝」，量少而慢。

entries.definition: To move food or liquid down the throat.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「吞咽」，对象不限于液体。

entries.definition: A drink, used in formal or commercial language.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「饮料」，语体偏正式或商业。

normalIntro.en: These hooks tie the irregular past forms to the path from swallowing to liquor.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子把不规则过去式与「从吞咽到酒」的路径绑在一起。

normal.en: Drink, drank, drunk keeps the vowel moving back like liquid going down.
normal.cn: drink、drank、drunk 的元音一路后退，像液体往下走。

normal.en: What you swallow is also called a drink, so the noun copies the verb.
normal.cn: 被吞下的东西也叫 drink，名词正是照抄动词。

normal.en: Unmarked drink means liquor, which is why doctors say stop drinking.
normal.cn: 不加修饰的 drink 指酒，所以医生说「别再喝酒」。

normal.en: Drink to someone is to raise a glass in their honour.
normal.cn: drink to 某人就是为某人举杯。

normal.en: Drinkable water is water that is safe to swallow.
normal.cn: drinkable water 就是可以安全吞下的水。

abstract.en: Picture a glass tilted up and emptied in one go.
abstract.cn: 想象一只杯子被仰起、一口气喝空。

abstract.en: Picture condensation running down a cold bottle.
abstract.cn: 想象冷瓶子上滑下的水珠。

abstract.en: Picture a table with two glasses raised together.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上两只杯子同时举起。

examples.en: He drank two cups of tea before the meeting.
examples.cn: 开会前他喝了两杯茶。

examples.en: The shop sells snacks and drinks by the door.
examples.cn: 这家店在门口卖零食和饮料。

examples.en: She does not drink, so she ordered soda.
examples.cn: 她不喝酒，所以点了苏打水。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「准渴」——一渴就得喝，drink 既是「喝」，也是「喝的东西」。

root: 来自古英语 drincan（喝），属日耳曼语词族，可追溯到表示「吸入液体」的印欧词根（确切形式有争议）。过去式 drank、过去分词 drunk 不规则。名词由「吞咽」转指被吞下的液体，再默认指酒，动词随之发展出「酗酒」义。

sensesIntro.en: The act of swallowing, the liquid swallowed, the liquor meant by default, and the habit all live in one word.
sensesIntro.cn: 吞咽的动作、被吞下的液体、默认所指的酒，以及饮酒的习惯，都住在同一个词里。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a glass tilted to the lips and emptied.
core.cn: 核心意象：杯子倾到嘴边被喝空。

branches.en: ACTION: the verb keeps the plain physical act.
branches.cn: 动作线：动词保留最朴素的物理动作，即第一个义项。

branches.en: THING: any potable liquid takes the action's name.
branches.cn: 事物线：任何可饮的液体都沿用动作之名，即第二个义项。

branches.en: LIQUOR: the default reading of an unmarked drink is alcohol.
branches.cn: 酒线：不加修饰的 drink 默认读作酒，即第三个义项。

branches.en: HABIT: repeated drinking becomes a behaviour to warn about.
branches.cn: 习惯线：反复饮酒变成需要告诫的行为，即第四个义项。

branches.en: The verb and the noun are the same event seen from two sides.
branches.cn: 动词与名词，是同一件事从两个侧面看。

intro.en: Drink is a strong Germanic verb with irregular forms, and it builds a small family.
intro.cn: drink 是形式不规则的强势日耳曼语动词，词族不大但活跃。

latinIntro.en: No Latin ancestor is involved; the endings -er, -able and -ing are English.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语祖先；-er、-able、-ing 都是英语词尾。

items.example: The old verb is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: 这个古动词是直接来源。

derivatives.zh: 由 drink 加 -er 构成，义为「饮酒者」
由 drink 加 -able 构成，义为「可饮用的」

definition_zh: 驾驶；开车送人；驱赶；驱动；迫使；推动；干劲
definition_en: to operate a vehicle, to carry someone by car, to force something away, to power a machine, to make someone act, to cause something to grow, or the energy that keeps a person going
core_image: 一双手握住方向盘，把静止的车和犹疑的人一起向前推
scene: 雨夜的高速上，仪表盘的灯亮着，前方的车流缓慢移动。She had to drive for six hours before the rain finally stopped.
sceneCN: 这里 drive 是「驾驶」（第 1 个义项：操控车辆行进）；句意是她开了六个小时车，雨才终于停。

pos.zh: 动词：驾驶；开车送；驱赶；驱动；迫使；推动
名词：驾车出行；车道；干劲；驱动装置

derivatives.zh: 由本词加施事后缀 -er 构成，义为「司机；驱动因素；驱动程序」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「驾驶；驾车」
由本词与 in 复合，义为「免下车服务的场所」
由前缀 over- 加本词构成，义为「超速挡；过度驱策」

senses.title: To operate a vehicle
senses.definition: to operate and control a car, bus, truck or other vehicle so that it moves
senses.definitionCN: 操控汽车、公交车、卡车等车辆使其行进
senses.example: She drives to work every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天早上开车去上班。
senses.why: The core meaning is control over motion: the verb took the sense of steering a vehicle from the older sense of pushing something forward.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是对运动的掌控：这个动词是从更早的「把东西向前推」引申出「操控车辆」之义。

senses.title: To take someone by car
senses.definition: to take a person somewhere in a vehicle and usually leave them there
senses.definitionCN: 用车辆把人送到某处，通常让其在那里下车
senses.example: He drove his mother to the airport before dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 他天没亮就开车送母亲去机场。
senses.why: Once driving a car became common, the verb naturally absorbed the purpose of the trip: the driver carries the passenger along.
senses.whyCN: 当开车成为日常之后，这个动词自然吸收了出行的目的：司机把乘客一起带着走。

senses.title: To force away
senses.definition: to force animals or people to move away from a place, often by chasing or frightening them
senses.definitionCN: 通过追赶或恐吓迫使动物、人离开某处
senses.example: The farmer drove the sheep into the lower field.
senses.exampleCN: 农夫把羊群赶进了下面的牧场。
senses.why: This is the oldest surviving sense: herding animals means pushing them from behind until they go where you want.
senses.whyCN: 这是留存至今最古老的义项：赶牲口就是从后面推着它们，直到它们走到你要它们去的地方。

senses.title: To power a machine
senses.definition: to supply the power that makes a machine, engine or device work
senses.definitionCN: 为机器、发动机或装置提供使其运转的动力
senses.example: An electric motor drives the pump.
senses.exampleCN: 一台电动机驱动这台泵。
senses.why: The industrial age reused the pushing image: a motor pushes a shaft the way a person pushes a cart.
senses.whyCN: 工业时代复用了这个「推」的意象：马达推动转轴，就像人推车一样。

senses.title: To make someone act
senses.definition: to cause or force a person to do something, especially something difficult or unpleasant
senses.definitionCN: 使或迫使某人去做某事，尤指困难或不快之事
senses.example: Hunger drove him to look for work in the city.
senses.exampleCN: 饥饿迫使他到城里找工作。
senses.why: When an inner force pushes a person the way a herder pushes sheep, the verb moves from the field into the mind.
senses.whyCN: 当内心的力量像牧人赶羊一样推着一个人时，这个动词就从牧场走进了人的心里。

senses.title: To cause growth or change
senses.definition: to cause something such as growth, prices or progress to move forward or increase
senses.definitionCN: 促使增长、价格或进展等向前发展或上升
senses.example: The new policy is designed to drive economic growth.
senses.exampleCN: 这项新政策旨在推动经济增长。
senses.why: Economic writing treats growth as a vehicle or a machine that needs a force behind it, so the same verb serves business prose.
senses.whyCN: 经济类写作把增长当成需要后劲的车辆或机器，因此同一个动词也适用于商业文本。

senses.title: Energy or determination
senses.definition: a strong natural need or determination that keeps a person working toward a goal
senses.definitionCN: 使人持续朝目标努力的强烈内在需求或决心
senses.example: Her drive to finish the research surprised everyone.
senses.exampleCN: 她完成这项研究的干劲让所有人都感到意外。
senses.why: The noun keeps the metaphor alive: the force that pushed the machine is now inside the person, pushing them on.
senses.whyCN: 名词让这个比喻继续活着：推动机器的那股力现在进了人心里，推着人往前走。

intro.en: Drive is an Old English verb of the Germanic family; its past forms drove and driven are irregular and survive from that period.
intro.cn: drive 是日耳曼语族里的古英语动词；过去式 drove 与过去分词 driven 是不规则形式，从那个时期一直沿用至今。

items.en: A root connected with pushing or driving is usually reconstructed behind this family, but its exact shape and deeper origin remain uncertain.
items.cn: 这个词族背后通常被重构出一个与「推、驱赶」相关的词根，但其确切形式和更早来源仍不确定。

items.en: The Germanic verb is reconstructed as a strong verb meaning to drive, push or chase.
items.cn: 日耳曼语中的这个动词被重构为一个强变化动词，意为「驱赶、推动、追逐」。

items.en: Old English drifan meant to drive, force, hunt or pursue, and it was already used for herding animals.
items.cn: 古英语 drifan 意为「驱赶、迫使、追猎」，当时就用于赶牲口。

items.en: The past tense drove and the participle driven settled into their modern shapes during the Middle English period.
items.cn: 过去式 drove 与分词 driven 在中古英语时期固定为今天的形态。

items.en: With roads, carriages and later engines, the verb extended from animals and carts to vehicles and machinery.
items.cn: 随着道路、马车以及后来的发动机出现，这个动词从牲畜和推车扩展到车辆与机械。

items.en: The noun drive appeared for a trip by carriage or car, a road, a device that transmits power, and later a inner urge.
items.cn: 名词 drive 先后指乘马车或汽车的出行、一条车道、传动的装置，后来又指内心的冲劲。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms and relatives of the same verb; the near-meaning group gathers other ways of making something move or act.
note.cn: 形近组收同一动词的各种形式和亲属词；近义组收其他表示「使某物移动或行动」的说法。

entries.definition: The person who drives; formed from drive plus the agent suffix -er.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指驾驶的人，由 drive 加施事后缀 -er 构成。

entries.definition: The activity of operating a vehicle, or an adjective describing strong force.
entries.definitionCN: 名词或形容词，指驾驶行为，也可形容强劲的推动力。

entries.definition: The irregular past tense of drive; as a noun it can also mean a herd of animals.
entries.definitionCN: drive 的不规则过去式；作名词时还可指被赶着走的一群牲畜。

entries.definition: The past participle of drive, often used for people pushed by strong motivation.
entries.definitionCN: drive 的过去分词，常用于形容被强烈动机推动的人。

entries.definition: To control the direction of a vehicle; it stresses direction rather than power.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「操纵方向」，强调方向而非动力。

entries.definition: To push or move something forward with force; more physical and technical than drive.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「推进、推动」，比 drive 更偏物理和技术语境。

entries.definition: To move something away by pressing it; the simple physical act behind the metaphor of drive.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「推」，是 drive 这一比喻背后最朴素的物理动作。

entries.definition: To strongly encourage someone to act; it works on persuasion rather than force.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「敦促、力劝」，靠劝说而非强力。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the real Old English verb and its irregular forms, then connect the physical push to the modern senses.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子沿着真实的古英语动词及其不规则形式展开，再把「推」这个动作连到现代义项。

normal.en: Old English drifan meant to drive animals forward, so the first picture is a herder behind a flock.
normal.cn: 古英语 drifan 意为把牲畜往前赶，所以第一个画面是牧人跟在羊群后面。

normal.en: The verb is irregular: drive, drove, driven, driving; learn the four shapes as one set.
normal.cn: 这个动词不规则：drive、drove、driven、driving，把这四个形态当成一组来记。

normal.en: Driver is simply drive plus -er, the one who does the driving.
normal.cn: driver 就是 drive 加 -er，指做这件事的人。

normal.en: Drive out is to chase away; drive growth is to push it forward; both keep the same push.
normal.cn: drive out 是赶走，drive growth 是把增长往前推，两者都保留了同一个「推」。

normal.en: The noun drive can be a car trip, a road, a gear position or a strong inner urge.
normal.cn: 名词 drive 可以是一次驾车出行、一条车道、一个挡位，也可以是一股强烈的内在冲劲。

abstract.en: Picture a hand on a steering wheel and the same hand pushing a heavy cart: one motion, two scales.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手握方向盘，同一只手又在推一辆沉重的推车：同一个动作，两种尺度。

abstract.en: The force that moves a car and the force that moves a person are drawn as the same arrow, only the target changes.
abstract.cn: 推动汽车的力量与推动人的力量被画成同一支箭头，只是指向的对象变了。

abstract.en: Drive as a noun is that arrow turned inward, still pointing at a destination it cannot yet see.
abstract.cn: 作为名词的 drive 是那支箭头转向内心，仍指向一个还看不见的终点。

examples.en: She drives to work every morning.
examples.cn: 她每天早上开车去上班。

examples.en: The new policy is designed to drive economic growth.
examples.cn: 这项新政策旨在推动经济增长。

examples.en: He was driven by a strong desire to prove himself.
examples.cn: 他被一股强烈的自我证明的欲望所驱使。

dict_mnemonic.text: dr- 有推、赶的感觉：drive 是把车或人往前推，driver 就是推的那个人。

root: 古英语 drifan「驱赶、推动」，属日耳曼语族强变化动词，过去式 drove、过去分词 driven；同族词包括 driver、driving、overdrive。更早的印欧语来源一般与「推、驱赶」相关，但确切形式不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses of drive all share one push: a vehicle, a passenger, a herd, a machine, a person, an economy, or the inner force that keeps someone going.
sensesIntro.cn: drive 的七个义项共享同一个「推」：车辆、乘客、畜群、机器、人、经济，以及让人坚持下去的那股内在力量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand on a steering wheel, pushing a still car into motion.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手握住方向盘，把静止的车推入运动。

branches.en: THE ROAD: a person controls a vehicle, and the same trip carries a passenger along.
branches.cn: 道路线：人操控车辆，同一趟行程也把乘客一起带走。

branches.en: THE HERD: the oldest sense, where animals are pushed from behind until they move.
branches.cn: 畜群线：最古老的义项，牲畜被从后面推着走。

branches.en: THE MACHINE: a motor takes over the push and turns a shaft instead of a cart.
branches.cn: 机械线：马达接手了这个「推」，推动的不再是车而是转轴。

branches.en: THE MIND: an inner force pushes a person to act, as a herder pushes a flock.
branches.cn: 心智线：内心的力量推着人行动，就像牧人赶着羊群。

branches.en: THE ECONOMY AND THE SELF: growth is pushed forward, and the same force becomes a person's determination.
branches.cn: 经济与自我线：增长被往前推，同一股力又变成一个人的决心。

intro.en: Drive is a Germanic root word; English builds the family with ordinary suffixes and compounds rather than Latin affixes.
intro.cn: drive 是日耳曼语族的根词；英语主要靠普通后缀和复合来扩展词族，而不是拉丁语词缀。

latinIntro.en: Drive has no Latin source; Latin agere, to drive or do, is only a semantic parallel and not the origin of this word.
latinIntro.cn: drive 没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 agere（驱赶、做）只是语义上的对照，并不是这个词的来源。

items.example: The bare stem carries the idea of forcing something forward.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干本身带有「把某物往前赶」的意思。

items.example: The past tense keeps an old vowel pattern.
items.exampleCN: 这个过去式保留了古老的元音变化模式。

items.example: The participle is used in passive and adjectival roles.
items.exampleCN: 这个分词常用于被动和形容词位置。

items.meaning: a place used without leaving the car
items.example: The compound joins the verb to the adverb in.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词把动词和副词 in 连在一起。

items.meaning: to drive a vehicle briefly to judge it
items.example: The compound adds test to the verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词在动词前加了 test。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加施事后缀 -er 构成，义为「司机；驱动因素；驱动程序」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「驾驶；驾车」
由前缀 over- 加本词构成，义为「超速挡；过度驱策」

definition_zh: 司机；驾驶员；驱动因素；驱动程序；高尔夫木杆
definition_en: a person who drives a vehicle, a factor that makes something develop, a program that controls a piece of hardware, or a golf club used for long shots
core_image: 方向盘后的人，以及屏幕背后让机器转起来的那段程序
scene: 夜班公交靠站，车门打开，乘客陆续上车。The driver waited until everyone was seated before pulling away.
sceneCN: 这里 driver 是「司机」（第 1 个义项：驾驶车辆的人）；句意是司机等到所有人都坐好才把车开走。

pos.zh: 名词：司机；驱动因素；驱动程序；高尔夫木杆

derivatives.zh: 由本词加后缀 -less 构成，义为「无人驾驶的」
由动词 drive 加 -ing 构成，义为「驾驶；驾车」
由本词加抽象名词后缀 -ship 构成，义为「驾驶技艺；司机身份」

senses.title: A person who drives
senses.definition: a person who operates a car, bus, taxi, truck or other vehicle as a job or as a regular activity
senses.definitionCN: 以驾驶汽车、公交车、出租车、卡车等为职业或经常性活动的人
senses.example: The driver stopped at the corner to let the children cross.
senses.exampleCN: 司机在拐角处停车，让孩子们过马路。
senses.why: The suffix -er turns the action of driving into the person who performs it, a pattern English uses for countless occupations.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -er 把「驾驶」这个动作变成做这个动作的人，英语用这一模式造出了无数职业名称。

senses.title: A factor that drives change
senses.definition: an important force, factor or condition that causes growth, change or a particular result
senses.definitionCN: 促成增长、变化或某种结果的重要力量、因素或条件
senses.example: Exports were the main driver of growth that year.
senses.exampleCN: 出口是那一年增长的主要驱动因素。
senses.why: Business writing borrowed the vehicle image: a factor that pushes a result forward is pictured as the one at the wheel.
senses.whyCN: 商业写作借用了车辆意象：把推动结果的因素想象成坐在驾驶位上的人。

senses.title: Software that controls hardware
senses.definition: a program that allows the operating system to communicate with and control a printer, screen or other device
senses.definitionCN: 使操作系统能够与打印机、屏幕等设备通信并控制它们的程序
senses.example: You need to install the printer driver before printing.
senses.exampleCN: 打印之前你需要安装打印机驱动程序。
senses.why: Computing reused the word for whatever makes a device obey: the software is the invisible hand on the machine's wheel.
senses.whyCN: 计算机领域把这个词用来指让设备听命的东西：这段软件就是机器方向盘上那只看不见的手。

senses.title: A golf club for long shots
senses.definition: a club with a large head, used chiefly for long shots from the tee
senses.definitionCN: 头部较大、主要用于球座上远距离击球的球杆
senses.example: He took his driver out on the long par-five hole.
senses.exampleCN: 在那个长五杆洞，他掏出了木杆。
senses.why: The club is named for what it does: it drives the ball far down the fairway, the same push as the verb.
senses.whyCN: 球杆以它的作用命名：它把球远远地打进球道，还是动词那个「推」。

intro.en: Driver is an English agent noun built directly on the Old English verb drifan plus -er; the later technical senses are extensions of that role.
intro.cn: driver 是英语施事名词，直接由古英语动词 drifan 加 -er 构成；后来的技术义项都是这一角色的延伸。

items.en: The root behind the verb is generally connected with pushing or driving; its exact form and deeper origin are uncertain.
items.cn: 动词背后的词根一般与「推、驱赶」相关，其确切形式和更早来源不确定。

items.en: The Germanic strong verb for driving carried the sense of forcing or chasing something forward.
items.cn: 日耳曼语中表示「驱赶」的强变化动词带有「迫使或追逐某物向前」的意思。

items.en: Old English drifan supplied the verb; the agent noun came later, once the action needed a name for the person.
items.cn: 古英语 drifan 提供了动词；施事名词出现较晚，是在需要一个词来指做这件事的人之后。

items.en: The suffix -er was attached to the verb stem, giving a noun for the one who drives carts, animals or vehicles.
items.cn: 后缀 -er 加在动词词干上，造出指赶车、赶牲口或驾车之人的名词。

items.en: Driver is recorded for the person in charge of a vehicle or a team of animals; exact first uses are uncertain.
items.cn: driver 在十六世纪有记录，指负责车辆或一队牲畜的人；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The word was extended to invisible agents: a driver of growth, a software driver, and the golf club that drives the ball.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到看不见的施动者：增长的驱动因素、软件驱动，以及击球的木杆。

note.en: The look-alike group shows the verb and its forms; the near-meaning group lists people and things that operate or propel a vehicle.
note.cn: 形近组展示动词及其各种形式；近义组列出操控或推进车辆的人与物。

entries.definition: The verb from which driver is formed; it also has many non-driving senses.
entries.definitionCN: 构成 driver 的动词，本身也有许多与驾驶无关的义项。

entries.definition: The activity or adjective form of the verb, as in driving lessons or a driving rain.
entries.definitionCN: 动词的名词或形容词形式，如驾驶课、倾盆大雨。

entries.definition: The past participle, often describing a person pushed by strong motives.
entries.definitionCN: 过去分词，常形容被强烈动机推动的人。

entries.definition: The past tense of drive; separately, a noun for a herd being moved.
entries.definitionCN: drive 的过去式；另有名词义，指被赶着走的一群牲畜。

entries.definition: A person who drives a car, especially one who does so regularly; more formal than driver.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指经常开汽车的人，比 driver 更正式。

entries.definition: A person employed to drive a private car for someone else.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指受雇为他人开私家车的司机。

entries.definition: A person who operates a machine or vehicle; it stresses control of equipment.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指操作机器或车辆的人，强调对设备的操控。

entries.definition: A person who guides an aircraft or a ship; a steering role in another medium.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指驾驶飞机或船只的人，是另一种介质里的操控角色。

normalIntro.en: These hooks unpack drive plus -er and then follow the word into computing, business and golf.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子拆解 drive 加 -er，再把这个词追到计算机、商业和高尔夫语境里。

normal.en: Driver is drive plus -er: the person who does the driving.
normal.cn: driver 就是 drive 加 -er：做驾驶这件事的人。

normal.en: The same -er pattern gives teacher, worker and singer, so the noun feels familiar at once.
normal.cn: 同样的 -er 模式还造出 teacher、worker、singer，所以这个名词一眼就亲切。

normal.en: A device driver does not sit in a car; it is the program that makes a device obey.
normal.cn: device driver 并不坐在车里，它是让设备听命的那段程序。

normal.en: A driver of growth is the force at the wheel of an economy.
normal.cn: a driver of growth 是站在经济方向盘上的那股力量。

normal.en: In golf, the driver is the club that drives the ball farthest.
normal.cn: 在高尔夫里，driver 是把球击得最远的球杆。

abstract.en: Picture a driver seen from behind: the road ahead is visible, the face is not.
abstract.cn: 想象从背后看一位司机：前方的路看得见，脸却看不见。

abstract.en: The same silhouette reappears inside a computer as a small program seated at an imaginary wheel.
abstract.cn: 同一个剪影又在电脑里出现，变成一段坐在想象中方向盘前的小程序。

abstract.en: In every sense, the driver is the one who makes something else go.
abstract.cn: 无论哪个义项，driver 都是让别的东西动起来的那一个。

examples.en: The driver of the white van waved us through.
examples.cn: 白色厢式货车的司机挥手示意我们过去。

examples.en: Tourism is a major driver of the local economy.
examples.cn: 旅游业是当地经济的主要驱动力。

examples.en: The update installed a new audio driver on his laptop.
examples.cn: 这次更新在他的笔记本电脑上装了一个新的音频驱动。

dict_mnemonic.text: drive 是「驾驶」，加 -er 就是「开车的人」；再由「操控者」引申到驱动因素和驱动程序。

root: 由古英语动词 drifan「驱赶、推动」加施事后缀 -er 构成，本义为「赶车、驾车的人」；drove、driven 是该动词的不规则过去式与过去分词。更早的印欧语来源一般与「推、驱赶」相关，确切形式不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of driver all name something that makes another thing move: a person, a factor, a program, or a club.
sensesIntro.cn: driver 的四个义项都在指「让另一事物动起来的东西」：一个人、一个因素、一段程序或一根球杆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a figure at a steering wheel, making a still machine move.
core.cn: 核心意象：方向盘前的一个身影，让静止的机器动起来。

branches.en: THE ROAD: a person whose job or habit is to operate a vehicle.
branches.cn: 道路线：以驾驶车辆为职业或习惯的人。

branches.en: THE ECONOMY: the invisible hand that pushes growth or change forward.
branches.cn: 经济线：把增长或变化往前推的那只无形之手。

branches.en: THE MACHINE: a program that lets software take the wheel of a device.
branches.cn: 机器线：让软件替设备握住方向盘的程序。

branches.en: THE COURSE: a club that drives the ball down the fairway.
branches.cn: 球场线：把球远远击向球道的球杆。

branches.en: ONE ROLE: every sense is an agent that makes something else move or work.
branches.cn: 一个角色：每个义项都是让别的东西移动或运转的施动者。

intro.en: Driver is a transparent English formation: the Germanic verb stem plus the native agent suffix -er.
intro.cn: driver 是透明度很高的英语构词：日耳曼语动词词干加本族语施事后缀 -er。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin ancestor here; Latin agens, one who acts, is only a functional comparison.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语祖先；拉丁语 agens（行动者）只是功能上的类比。

items.example: The suffix turns the action into a person.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动作变成人。
它出现在 device driver 中。
它出现在 test driver 中。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加后缀 -less 构成，义为「无人驾驶的」
由动词 drive 加 -ing 构成，义为「驾驶；驾车」
由本词加抽象名词后缀 -ship 构成，义为「驾驶技艺；司机身份」

definition_zh: 滴落；落下；下降；顺路放下；放弃；一滴；跌幅
definition_en: to fall in small amounts, to let something fall, to become lower, to leave someone somewhere, to leave something out, or a small amount of liquid and the fall it makes
core_image: 水珠从叶尖脱手，坠向石阶的一瞬
scene: 屋檐下的水珠一颗接一颗砸在石阶上。A single drop fell from the leaf and broke on the stone.
sceneCN: 这里 drop 是「一滴」（第 6 个义项：液体的一小滴）；句意是一滴水珠从叶上落下，在石头上碎开。

pos.zh: 动词：滴落；落下；下降；顺路放下；放弃
名词：一滴；少量；下降；落差

derivatives.zh: 由本词加指小后缀 -let 构成，义为「小水滴」
由本词加施事后缀 -er 构成，义为「滴管；滴瓶」
由本词与 out 复合，义为「退学者；退出者」
由 rain 与本词复合，义为「雨滴」

senses.title: To fall in drops
senses.definition: to fall in single drops, as a liquid does from a roof, a tap or a leaf
senses.definitionCN: 以单颗液滴的形式落下，如从屋顶、水龙头或叶子上滴落
senses.example: Water dropped from the leaking pipe all night.
senses.exampleCN: 漏水的水管整夜都在往下滴水。
senses.why: This is the word at its origin: the noun for a single bead of liquid turned into the motion that bead makes.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词的源头：表示单颗液滴的名词，变成了这颗液滴所做的动作。

senses.title: To fall or let fall
senses.definition: to fall suddenly, or to release something so that it falls, often by accident
senses.definitionCN: 突然落下，或松手让某物掉落，常属意外
senses.example: She dropped the keys on the table.
senses.exampleCN: 她把钥匙掉在了桌上。
senses.why: From liquid falling the verb widened to any object that leaves the hand, keeping the same downward motion.
senses.whyCN: 从液体滴落扩展到任何离开手的物体，向下这个动作保持不变。

senses.title: To become lower
senses.definition: to decrease in amount, level, temperature, price or value
senses.definitionCN: 在数量、水平、温度、价格或价值上降低
senses.example: Temperatures drop sharply after sunset.
senses.exampleCN: 日落后气温急剧下降。
senses.why: A falling object and a falling number share the same downward line, so the verb moved easily from the physical to the measurable.
senses.whyCN: 落下的物体与下跌的数字共享同一条向下的线，动词于是很容易从物理世界跨到可度量之物。

senses.title: To leave someone somewhere
senses.definition: to take a person or thing to a place and leave them there, often on the way to somewhere else
senses.definitionCN: 把人或物送到某处并留在那里，通常是在去别处的路上
senses.example: He dropped his sister at the station.
senses.exampleCN: 他把妹妹送到了车站。
senses.why: The passenger is 'dropped' the way a parcel is set down: the vehicle stops, the person leaves, the trip goes on.
senses.whyCN: 乘客就像被放下的包裹：车停下、人离开、行程继续，所以用 drop。

senses.title: To leave out or stop
senses.definition: to leave something out of a plan, list or story, or to stop doing something
senses.definitionCN: 把某事物从计划、名单或报道中删去，或停止做某事
senses.example: The magazine dropped the story at the last minute.
senses.exampleCN: 杂志在最后一刻撤下了那篇报道。
senses.why: Something removed from a plan falls out of it, so the physical fall becomes a metaphor for withdrawal.
senses.whyCN: 从计划中被删去的东西像是掉了出去，于是物理上的「落」变成了「撤回」的比喻。

senses.title: A small amount of liquid
senses.definition: a small rounded amount of liquid that falls or hangs from something
senses.definitionCN: 从某物落下或悬挂着的一小颗圆形液体
senses.example: A drop of oil stained the page.
senses.exampleCN: 一滴油在书页上留下了污渍。
senses.why: This is the original noun: the shape a liquid takes when surface tension holds it together before it falls.
senses.whyCN: 这是原始的名词义：液体在落下之前被表面张力聚成的那个形状。

senses.title: A fall in amount
senses.definition: a fall or decrease in amount, level, price or value
senses.definitionCN: 数量、水平、价格或价值的下降或减少
senses.example: The company reported a sharp drop in sales.
senses.exampleCN: 公司报告销售额急剧下降。
senses.why: The verb's downward motion returns as a noun, now measuring how far a figure has fallen.
senses.whyCN: 动词的向下运动又变回名词，用来衡量一个数字跌了多远。

intro.en: Drop belongs to the same Germanic family as drip; a noun for the bead of liquid came first, and the verb grew from it.
intro.cn: drop 与 drip 同属一个日耳曼语词族；先有表示液滴的名词，动词再从它生长出来。

items.en: A root connected with dripping or falling in small amounts is generally reconstructed, but its exact shape is uncertain.
items.cn: 一般会重构出一个与「滴落、少量落下」相关的词根，但其确切形式不确定。

items.en: The Germanic noun for a drop is reconstructed with a shape close to drup-, and the related verb underlies drip.
items.cn: 日耳曼语中表示「一滴」的名词被重构为接近 drup- 的形式，相关的动词则是 drip 的来源。

items.en: Old English dropa meant a drop of liquid, and the verb dropian is also recorded.
items.cn: 古英语 dropa 意为「一滴液体」，动词 dropian 也有记录。

items.en: Middle English drope kept the noun, while the verb spread from liquids to any falling object.
items.cn: 中古英语 drope 保留了名词，动词则从液体扩展到任何下落的物体。

items.en: The verb gained the senses of letting something fall and of leaving a person at a place.
items.cn: 动词发展出「让某物落下」和「把人放在某处」的义项。

items.en: Business and journalism turned drop into a measure of decline, as in a sharp drop in sales.
items.cn: 商业与新闻业把 drop 变成衡量跌幅的词，如销售额的急剧下降。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same dripping family or with a similar shape; the near-meaning group gathers other verbs of falling and declining.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「滴落」词族的词或外形相近的词；近义组收其他表示「落下、下降」的动词。

entries.definition: A very small drop of liquid; formed from drop with the diminutive suffix -let.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指极小的液滴，由 drop 加指小后缀 -let 构成。

entries.definition: To fall in drops slowly and regularly, or the sound and liquid of such a fall.
entries.definitionCN: 动词或名词，指缓慢而有规律地滴落，也指滴落的声音和液体。

entries.definition: To bend or hang downward, as a tired flower does; a different word despite the similar shape.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「下垂、萎靡」，如疲倦的花朵；虽然外形相近，却是另一个词。

entries.definition: A person who leaves school or a course before finishing; drop plus out.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指中途退学或退出课程的人，由 drop 加 out 构成。

entries.definition: To move downward under gravity; the most general verb for the motion.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「落下」，是表示这一运动最通用的词。

entries.definition: To become smaller or weaker over time; more gradual and formal than drop.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「下降、衰退」，比 drop 更渐进、更正式。

entries.definition: To become less in number or size; neutral and measurable.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「减少」，中性且可度量。

entries.definition: To fall or drop suddenly and steeply; stronger and more dramatic than drop.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「骤降、猛跌」，比 drop 更强烈、更具戏剧性。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from the single bead of water and follow it down into prices, passengers and cancelled plans.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从那一小颗水珠出发，跟着它一路落到价格、乘客和被取消的计划里。

normal.en: Picture one bead of water at the tip of a leaf: that bead is a drop.
normal.cn: 想象叶尖上的一颗水珠：这颗水珠就是一个 drop。

normal.en: The verb is regular: drop, dropped, dropped, dropping; double the final p before -ed and -ing.
normal.cn: 这个动词是规则的：drop、dropped、dropped、dropping；加 -ed 和 -ing 前要双写词尾的 p。

normal.en: Prices drop, temperatures drop and sales drop: the same downward line drawn on a chart.
normal.cn: 价格 drop、气温 drop、销售 drop，都是图表上同一条向下的线。

normal.en: Drop someone off means set them down and drive on; drop a plan means set the plan down for good.
normal.cn: drop someone off 是把人放下后继续开车；drop a plan 是把计划永久放下。

normal.en: A drop of rain and a sharp drop in sales use the same noun for two very different falls.
normal.cn: a drop of rain 与 a sharp drop in sales 用同一个名词表示两种截然不同的下落。

abstract.en: Picture a bead of water shrinking as it falls, then landing as a circle on stone.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗水珠在下落中收缩，最后在石头上落成一个圆。

abstract.en: The same bead can be redrawn as a point on a graph sliding down the y-axis.
abstract.cn: 同一颗水珠可以被重画成图表上沿纵轴下滑的一个点。

abstract.en: Every sense of drop is one small thing leaving a higher place for a lower one.
abstract.cn: drop 的每个义项，都是一件小东西从高处离开、去往低处。

examples.en: A drop of rain rolled down the window.
examples.cn: 一滴雨顺着窗玻璃滚了下来。

examples.en: Prices dropped sharply after the new supply arrived.
examples.cn: 新货源到达后，价格急剧下跌。

examples.en: Could you drop me at the next corner?
examples.cn: 你能在下一个路口让我下车吗？

dict_mnemonic.text: drop 本是一颗水滴，动词就是这颗水滴往下落；由「落下」再引申出下降、放下、放弃。

root: 古英语 dropa 意为「一滴液体」，与 drip 同属一个日耳曼语词族，其名词先于动词出现；中古英语 drope 保留名词，动词逐渐从液体扩展到一切下落之物。更早的印欧语词根一般与「滴落」相关，确切形式不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Seven senses of drop all describe one small amount leaving a higher place: liquid, an object, a number, a passenger, a plan, or the measured fall itself.
sensesIntro.cn: drop 的七个义项都在描述「一小份东西离开高处」：液体、物体、数字、乘客、计划，或这次下落本身的幅度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one bead of water leaves a leaf and falls to the stone below.
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗水珠离开叶子，坠向下面的石头。

branches.en: THE BEAD: the noun at its most concrete, a single rounded piece of liquid.
branches.cn: 水珠线：名词最具体的一端，一颗圆形的液体。

branches.en: THE FALL: liquid falls by itself, and a hand can let an object fall the same way.
branches.cn: 下落线：液体自行落下，手也能以同样的方式让物体落下。

branches.en: THE CHART: the downward line is redrawn as falling prices and temperatures.
branches.cn: 图表线：这条向下的线被重画成下跌的价格与气温。

branches.en: THE LEAVING: a passenger is set down, and a plan is set down for good.
branches.cn: 离开线：乘客被放下，计划也被永久放下。

branches.en: THE MEASURE: the noun returns to name how far a figure has fallen.
branches.cn: 度量线：名词回来指一个数字跌了多远。

intro.en: Drop is a native Germanic noun-verb pair; its family is built with native suffixes and compounds.
intro.cn: drop 是本族语的日耳曼语名动同形词；词族靠本族语后缀和复合构成。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source; Latin gutta, a drop, is a semantic counterpart rather than an ancestor.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 gutta（一滴）只是语义上的对应，并非祖先。

items.meaning: a bead of liquid; to fall
items.example: The same shape serves as noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 同一个形态兼作名词与动词。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加指小后缀 -let 构成，义为「小水滴」
由本词加施事后缀 -er 构成，义为「滴管；滴瓶」
由本词与 out 复合，义为「退学者；退出者」

definition_zh: 药物；毒品；麻醉剂；给……下药
definition_en: a substance used to treat illness, an illegal substance taken for pleasure, a substance that alters the mind or body, or to give such a substance to someone
core_image: 一只贴着标签的小瓶，既可能救命，也可能夺走清醒
scene: 诊所的柜子里排着一排贴着标签的小瓶，瓶身反着冷光。The doctor warned him not to mix the drug with alcohol.
sceneCN: 这里 drug 是「药物」（第 1 个义项：用于治疗疾病的药）；句意是医生告诫他不要把这药和酒混在一起。

collocations.zh: 给病人用药物使其麻木

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ist 构成，义为「药剂师；药商」
由本词与 store 复合，义为「药店；杂货药房」
由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「被下了药的；麻木的」

senses.title: A medicine
senses.definition: a substance used to treat, cure or prevent an illness or to relieve symptoms
senses.definitionCN: 用于治疗、治愈或预防疾病，或缓解症状的物质
senses.example: The drug lowered her blood pressure within an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药在一小时内降低了她的血压。
senses.why: The word began in pharmacy, where a dried plant or prepared substance was the unit of treatment; this is still its neutral medical sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词起源于药学，那里一份干燥的草药或配好的制剂就是治疗的单位；这仍是它中性的医学义。

senses.title: An illegal substance
senses.definition: an illegal substance, often addictive, taken for pleasure or escape rather than for medical treatment
senses.definitionCN: 常具成瘾性、非为治疗而只为快感或逃避而服用的非法物质
senses.example: The police seized a large amount of the drug at the border.
senses.exampleCN: 警方在边境查获了大量这种毒品。
senses.why: When the same substances left the clinic and entered the street, the neutral word acquired a strong negative sense that now often comes first to mind.
senses.whyCN: 当同样的物质离开诊所、进入街头，这个中性词就带上了强烈的负面义，如今往往最先被想到。

senses.title: A substance affecting the mind or body
senses.titleCN: 麻醉剂；作用于身心的物质
senses.definition: a substance that alters consciousness, sensation or bodily function, such as a narcotic or anaesthetic
senses.definitionCN: 改变意识、感觉或身体机能的物质，如麻醉剂或镇静剂
senses.example: The patient was given a drug to ease the pain.
senses.exampleCN: 医生给病人用了一种药来止痛。
senses.why: This sense sits between medicine and narcotic: the substance is used medically, but what it does is change how the body feels.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项介于药物与毒品之间：它被医学使用，但作用在于改变身体的感受。

senses.title: To give someone a drug
senses.definition: to give a drug to a person or animal, especially secretly or to make them unconscious
senses.definitionCN: 给某人或动物用药，尤指偷偷地或为使其失去知觉
senses.example: Someone had drugged his drink.
senses.exampleCN: 有人在他的饮料里下了药。
senses.why: The verb turns the substance into an act of control: one person quietly takes away another person's clear senses.
senses.whyCN: 动词把物质变成一种控制行为：一个人悄悄夺走另一个人清醒的意识。

intro.en: Drug entered English through Old French in the Middle Ages, and its further origin is genuinely uncertain; several explanations compete.
intro.cn: drug 在中世纪经由古法语进入英语，更早的来源确实不确定，存在几种相互竞争的解释。

items.en: Old French drogue meant a medicine or a substance used in pharmacy, and it is the immediate source of the English word.
items.cn: 古法语 drogue 意为「药物」或药房所用的「原料」，是英语这个词的直接来源。

items.en: Middle English drogge appears in medical and trade texts, often for dried plant materials sold by apothecaries.
items.cn: 中古英语 drogge 出现在医学与贸易文本中，常指药剂师出售的干燥植物原料。

items.en: One common suggestion links the word to Dutch droog, dry, because many early drugs were dried herbs; this is plausible but not proved.
items.cn: 一种常见说法把它与荷兰语 droog（干燥）联系起来，因为早期药物多为干燥草药；此说合理但未获证明。

items.en: Other accounts point to an Arabic source through Mediterranean trade; the evidence is indirect and scholars do not agree.
items.cn: 另有说法认为它经地中海贸易来自阿拉伯语；证据是间接的，学界并无共识。

items.en: The word is recorded in English from the fourteenth century, at first in pharmacy; exact first uses are uncertain.
items.cn: 这个词在十四世纪见于英语，最初用于药学；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: The sense of an illegal or addictive substance developed in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, and the verb followed it.
items.cn: 「非法或成瘾性物质」这一义项在十九、二十世纪发展出来，动词用法也随之出现。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on drug or easily confused with it; the near-meaning group separates medicine, medication and remedy by their scope and tone.
note.cn: 形近组收由 drug 构成或容易混淆的词；近义组按范围与语气区分 medicine、medication 与 remedy。

entries.definition: A person who prepares and sells medicines; drug plus the person suffix -ist.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指配制和出售药品的人，由 drug 加表人后缀 -ist 构成。

entries.definition: A shop that sells medicines and also household goods; drug plus store.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指出售药品并兼卖日用品的商店，由 drug 加 store 构成。

entries.definition: Having been given a drug, often secretly; the past participle used as an adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指被下了药的，常指被人偷偷下药；由过去分词转作形容词。

entries.definition: A percussion instrument; it looks close to drug but has an unrelated musical origin.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「鼓」；拼写与 drug 接近，但来源是另一条音乐词源。

entries.definition: A substance taken to treat illness; neutral and strongly medical, without the street sense.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「药、药物」，中性且医学色彩强，不含街头义。

entries.definition: A drug prescribed for a patient; formal and clinical, used mostly in medical contexts.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「药物、处方药」，正式而临床，多用于医疗语境。

entries.definition: A treatment or cure, often a simple one; it stresses restoring health rather than the substance.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「疗法、补救办法」，常指简易疗法，强调恢复健康而非物质本身。

entries.definition: A drug that dulls pain and may cause sleep or addiction; a narrower, more technical term.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「麻醉剂、毒品」，指镇痛并可能致睡或成瘾的药物，范围更窄、更技术化。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the pharmacy origin in view and then show how the same bottle acquired its darker sense.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子始终把药学来源放在眼前，再看同一只瓶子如何带上更阴暗的含义。

normal.en: Drug first meant a dried herb sold by an apothecary, so picture a paper packet of dried leaves.
normal.cn: drug 最初指药剂师出售的干燥草药，所以先想象一包干叶子。

normal.en: The verb is regular: drug, drugged, drugged, drugging; double the final g.
normal.cn: 这个动词是规则的：drug、drugged、drugged、drugging；词尾 g 要双写。

normal.en: Prescription drug is the medical side; drug abuse is the street side; the same word covers both.
normal.cn: prescription drug 是医学的一面，drug abuse 是街头的一面，同一个词覆盖两端。

normal.en: To drug someone is to take their clear senses away without asking.
normal.cn: to drug someone 就是在对方不知情时夺走其清醒的意识。

normal.en: Druggist and drugstore keep the old pharmacy meaning alive in everyday English.
normal.cn: druggist 与 drugstore 让古老的药学义在日常英语里继续活着。

abstract.en: Picture one small bottle on a shelf, with a label that could read either heal or harm.
abstract.cn: 想象架子上的一只小瓶，标签上既可能写着「治愈」，也可能写着「伤害」。

abstract.en: The same bottle moves from a clinic shelf to a street corner, and its meaning darkens with the journey.
abstract.cn: 同一只瓶子从诊所的架子走到街角，含义也随这段旅程变得阴暗。

abstract.en: Drug is a word about control: who decides what enters a body, and for what purpose.
abstract.cn: drug 是一个关于控制的词：由谁决定什么进入身体，又为了什么目的。

examples.en: The new drug has been approved for treating high blood pressure.
examples.cn: 这种新药已获准用于治疗高血压。

examples.en: The campaign warns young people against illegal drugs.
examples.cn: 这项运动警告年轻人远离非法毒品。

examples.en: The horse was drugged before the race and could not run.
examples.cn: 那匹马赛前被下了药，跑不起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: drug 本是药房里的一包干草药：治病时是药，滥用时是毒品，偷偷给人用就是「下药」。

root: 经由古法语 drogue（药物、药房原料）进入英语，更早来源不确定：一说与荷兰语 droog「干燥」有关，因早期药物多为干燥草药；另有经地中海贸易来自阿拉伯语的说法，均无定论。十四世纪起见于英语药学文本。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses of drug follow one substance from the pharmacy shelf to the street: a medicine, an illegal habit, a mind-altering dose, and the act of giving it secretly.
sensesIntro.cn: drug 的四个义项让同一种物质从药房架子走到街头：药物、非法瘾品、改变身心的药剂，以及偷偷给人用药的行为。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one labelled bottle that can either restore health or take away clear senses.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只贴标签的小瓶，既能恢复健康，也能夺走清醒。

branches.en: THE CLINIC: a prepared substance whose purpose is to treat or prevent illness.
branches.cn: 诊所线：以治疗或预防疾病为目的的制剂。

branches.en: THE STREET: the same substance sold illegally and taken for escape.
branches.cn: 街头线：同样的物质被非法出售，被用来逃避现实。

branches.en: THE BODY: a dose that changes consciousness, sensation or bodily function.
branches.cn: 身体线：改变意识、感觉或身体机能的剂量。

branches.en: THE ACT: giving the substance to someone, often without their knowledge.
branches.cn: 行为线：把这种物质给某人，往往在其不知情时。

branches.en: ONE SUBSTANCE, TWO REPUTATIONS: medicine and narcotic share a history and a word.
branches.cn: 同一物质，两种名声：药物与毒品共享一段历史和同一个词。

intro.en: Drug is a borrowed root with an uncertain deeper origin; English adds person, place and participle suffixes to build its family.
intro.cn: drug 是一个借入的词根，更深来源不确定；英语加表人、表地点和分词后缀来扩展词族。

latinIntro.en: No Latin ancestor is established; the Latin word for a drug, medicamentum, belongs to a different family.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有确立的拉丁语祖先；拉丁语表示药物的 medicamentum 属于另一个词族。

items.example: The root serves as both noun and verb.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根兼作名词与动词。
它出现在 drug abuse 中。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ist 构成，义为「药剂师；药商」
由本词与 store 复合，义为「药店；杂货药房」
由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「被下了药的；麻木的」

definition_zh: 干燥的；干旱的；干涸的；枯燥的；（酒）不甜的；使变干
definition_en: not wet, having little or no rain, empty of water, dull and without interest, not sweet as wine is, or to make something become dry
core_image: 一块被日光晒裂的泥土，裂缝里再挤不出一滴水
scene: 晾衣绳上的衬衫在风里轻轻晃动，边角已经硬挺。The clothes were dry long before sunset.
sceneCN: 这里 dry 是「干燥的」（第 1 个义项：不含水分、已被晾干）；句意是衣服在日落前很久就干了。

pos.zh: 形容词：干燥的；干旱的；枯燥的；不甜的

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「干燥；干旱」
由本词加施事后缀 -er 构成，义为「干燥机；吹风机」
由本词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「干巴巴地；冷峻地」
由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「干燥的；干制的」

senses.title: Not wet
senses.definition: having no water or moisture on the surface or inside
senses.definitionCN: 表面或内部没有水或湿气的
senses.example: The clothes were dry long before sunset.
senses.exampleCN: 衣服在日落前很久就干了。
senses.why: This is the physical core: whatever water has left is described as dry, and almost every other sense is a picture of that absence.
senses.whyCN: 这是物理核心：水分离开之后的状态就叫 dry，几乎其他所有义项都是这种「缺席」的画面。

senses.title: Having little rain
senses.definition: describing weather or a period with little or no rain
senses.definitionCN: 形容降雨很少或没有降雨的天气或时期
senses.example: The region has had a dry summer for three years.
senses.exampleCN: 这个地区已经连续三年经历干旱的夏天。
senses.why: When a whole season lacks water from the sky, the same adjective moves from a shirt to a landscape.
senses.whyCN: 当整个季节都缺天上的水，同一个形容词就从一件衬衫移到了一片土地。

senses.title: Empty of water
senses.definition: describing a well, river, lake or container that has no water left in it
senses.definitionCN: 形容井、河流、湖泊或容器里已经没有水
senses.example: The well ran dry in the middle of August.
senses.exampleCN: 那口井在八月中旬干涸了。
senses.why: A well that has nothing left is dry all the way down, so the adjective describes the inside as well as the surface.
senses.whyCN: 一滴不剩的井从上到下都是干的，所以这个形容词既描述表面，也描述内部。

senses.title: Dull and uninteresting
senses.definition: lacking interest, humour or emotion, especially in speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 缺乏趣味、幽默或情感的，尤指言谈或文字
senses.example: The lecture was accurate but dry.
senses.exampleCN: 那场讲座准确，却干巴巴的。
senses.why: A dry text is imagined as a landscape without water: correct in shape, but nothing flows.
senses.whyCN: 干巴巴的文字被想象成没有水的风景：形状没毛病，却什么也不流动。

senses.title: Not sweet, as wine
senses.definition: describing wine or other drinks that are not sweet, with all or most sugar fermented away
senses.definitionCN: 形容葡萄酒等饮品不含甜味，糖分已全部或大部分发酵掉
senses.example: She prefers a dry white wine to a sweet one.
senses.exampleCN: 比起甜白葡萄酒，她更喜欢不甜的那种。
senses.why: Winemakers borrow the word for 'without' again: a dry wine has no sweetness left, only the dry taste of fermentation.
senses.whyCN: 酿酒师又一次借用了「没有」这个词：dry wine 没有残留的甜味，只有发酵后的干涩口感。

senses.title: To make or become dry
senses.definition: to remove water from something, or to become dry
senses.definitionCN: 除去某物中的水分，或自身变干
senses.example: The lake dries up every summer.
senses.exampleCN: 这个湖每年夏天都会干涸。
senses.why: The verb is the adjective turned into an action: water leaves, and the object crosses into the dry state.
senses.whyCN: 动词是形容词变成的动作：水离开，物体进入干燥状态。

intro.en: Dry is a native Old English adjective with a Germanic past; the verb grew from the adjective rather than the other way round.
intro.cn: dry 是本族语的古英语形容词，有日耳曼语渊源；动词是从形容词生长出来的，而不是反过来。

items.en: A root meaning dry is generally reconstructed behind this family, but its exact form and deeper origin are uncertain.
items.cn: 这个词族背后一般被重构出一个表示「干燥」的词根，但其确切形式与更早来源不确定。

items.en: The Germanic adjective for dry is reconstructed in a form close to draugiz, with relatives in several modern languages.
items.cn: 日耳曼语中表示「干燥」的形容词被重构为接近 draugiz 的形式，在多种现代语言中都有亲属词。

items.en: Old English dryge meant dry, and it already described land, weather and objects without moisture.
items.cn: 古英语 dryge 意为「干燥的」，当时已用于描述土地、天气和没有水分的物体。

items.en: Middle English drie kept the physical sense and began to be used for dull speech and unsweet drinks.
items.cn: 中古英语 drie 保留了物理义，并开始用于干巴巴的言辞和不甜的酒。

items.en: Dried fruit, dry goods and dry wine fixed the commercial senses; the verb dry is recorded alongside them.
items.cn: 干果、干货与不甜的酒固定了商业义项；动词 dry 也同期有记录。

items.en: Dry humour, dry up and dry cleaner show how far the one image of missing water has travelled.
items.cn: dry humour、dry up 与 dry cleaner 说明「缺水」这一意象走了多远。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms built on dry; the near-meaning group separates arid, parched and dull, which differ in scope and tone.
note.cn: 形近组收由 dry 构成的词形；近义组区分 arid、parched 与 dull，它们范围与语气不同。

entries.definition: The comparative of dry, or a device that removes moisture; context decides which.
entries.definitionCN: dry 的比较级，也可指干燥设备；具体含义由语境决定。

entries.definition: The state or quality of being dry; dry plus -ness.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指干燥的状态或性质，由 dry 加 -ness 构成。

entries.definition: Having had the water removed, as in dried fruit; the past participle used as an adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指已去掉水分的，如干果；过去分词转作形容词。

entries.definition: A machine that dries clothes, hair or hands; dry plus -er.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，指烘干衣物、头发或手的机器，由 dry 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: Very dry, especially of land with too little rain for most plants; technical and climatic.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「干旱的」，尤指降雨太少、多数植物无法生长的土地，属气候术语。

entries.definition: Extremely dry from heat, as land or a throat; stronger and more vivid than dry.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「焦干的」，如土地或喉咙，比 dry 更强烈、更形象。

entries.definition: Not interesting or lively; it matches the figurative sense of dry, not the physical one.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「乏味的」，只对应 dry 的比喻义，而非物理义。

entries.definition: Unable to produce plants or crops; it stresses poor yield rather than low moisture.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「贫瘠的、不毛的」，强调产量低而非水分少。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with the missing water and then follow the same absence into weather, speech and wine.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子从「缺席的水」开始，再跟着这份缺席走进天气、言辞与葡萄酒。

normal.en: Dry begins as a simple absence: no water on the surface and none inside.
normal.cn: dry 最初就是一个简单的缺席：表面没有水，里面也没有。

normal.en: The verb changes y to i: dry, dries, dried, drying.
normal.cn: 这个动词要把 y 变 i：dry、dries、dried、drying。

normal.en: A dry summer, a dry well and a dry lake are all the same missing water at different scales.
normal.cn: 干旱的夏天、干涸的井、干涸的湖，都是不同尺度上同一种缺失的水。

normal.en: A dry lecture has no flow, and a dry wine has no sweetness; both are pictures of 'without'.
normal.cn: 干巴巴的讲座没有流动感，不甜的酒没有甜味，两者都是「没有」的画面。

normal.en: Dry cleaner does not use water, which is why the name fits so well.
normal.cn: dry cleaner 不用水，所以这个名字格外贴切。

abstract.en: Picture cracked earth after a long rainless month, with the cracks forming a map of absence.
abstract.cn: 想象一个月无雨之后裂开的土地，裂缝画成一张「缺席」的地图。

abstract.en: The same map can be drawn on a page of dull prose, where nothing flows between the lines.
abstract.cn: 同一张地图可以画在一页乏味的文字上，行与行之间什么也不流动。

abstract.en: Dry is a word for what is not there, and every sense points at a different missing thing.
abstract.cn: dry 是一个关于「不在场」的词，每个义项都指向不同的缺席之物。

examples.en: The clothes were dry long before sunset.
examples.cn: 衣服在日落前很久就干了。

examples.en: Her throat felt dry after the long speech.
examples.cn: 长时间讲话后，她的喉咙发干。

examples.en: The lake dries up every summer.
examples.cn: 这个湖每年夏天都会干涸。

dict_mnemonic.text: dry 是一块晒裂的土：没有水就是干；天气没雨是干旱；话没味道是枯燥；酒没糖是不甜。

root: 古英语 dryge「干燥的」，属日耳曼语族，同源形式见于多种现代语言；中古英语作 drie。更早的印欧语词根一般表示「干燥」，确切形式不确定。动词义在早期近代英语中与形容词并用而固定下来。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses of dry all describe something missing: water from a surface, rain from a season, water from a well, interest from speech, sugar from wine, and water leaving through the verb.
sensesIntro.cn: dry 的六个义项都在描述某种缺席：表面缺水、季节缺雨、井里缺水、言谈缺趣味、酒里缺糖，以及动词所指的水离开。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: cracked earth under a hard sun, with no water left anywhere.
core.cn: 核心意象：烈日下裂开的土地，哪里都再挤不出一滴水。

branches.en: THE SURFACE: a shirt, a hand or a road with no moisture on it.
branches.cn: 表面线：衬衫、手或道路表面没有湿气。

branches.en: THE LAND: a season without rain and a well or lake with nothing left inside.
branches.cn: 土地线：没有降雨的季节，以及内部一滴不剩的井或湖。

branches.en: THE PAGE: speech or writing with no flow of interest or feeling.
branches.cn: 书页线：言谈或文字里没有趣味与情感的流动。

branches.en: THE GLASS: wine with all its sweetness fermented away.
branches.cn: 酒杯线：甜味已被全部发酵掉的葡萄酒。

branches.en: THE ACTION: the verb follows the water as it leaves.
branches.cn: 动作线：动词跟着水一起离开。

intro.en: Dry is a native adjective; English adds -ness, -er, -ly and -ed, and forms compounds such as dry-clean and sun-dry.
intro.cn: dry 是本族语形容词；英语加 -ness、-er、-ly、-ed，并构成 dry-clean、sun-dry 等复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source; Latin siccus, dry, is a semantic counterpart only.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语来源；拉丁语 siccus（干燥的）只是语义上的对应。

items.example: The adjective is the base of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词是词族的基础。

items.meaning: to clean with chemicals instead of water
items.meaningCN: 用化学品而非水来清洗
items.example: The compound joins dry to clean.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词把 dry 与 clean 连在一起。

items.meaning: to dry by exposing to the sun
items.example: The compound joins sun to dry.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词把 sun 与 dry 连在一起。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「干燥；干旱」
由本词加施事后缀 -er 构成，义为「干燥机；吹风机」
由本词加副词后缀 -ly 构成，义为「干巴巴地；冷峻地」
由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「干燥的；干制的」
